title: 哪个最长？哪个最短？
quizName: Which Is the Longest? Which Is the Shortest? Reading Quiz
lessonText: 尺子长，教杆短。尺子比教杆长。
教杆长，铅笔短。教杆比铅笔长。
铅笔长，水彩笔短。铅笔比水彩笔长。
水彩笔长，白板笔短。水彩笔比白板笔长。
白板笔长，蜡笔短。白板笔比蜡笔长。
蜡笔长，橡皮短。蜡笔比橡皮长。

storyLang.pinyin: nǎ ge zuì cháng nǎ ge zuì duǎn
storyLang.english: Which Is the Longest? Which Is the Shortest?

storyLang.pinyin: chǐ zi cháng jiào gǎn duǎn chǐ zi bǐ jiào gǎn cháng
storyLang.english: The ruler is long, and the teaching pointer is short. The ruler is longer than the teaching pointer.

storyLang.pinyin: jiào gǎn cháng qiān bǐ duǎn jiào gǎn bǐ qiān bǐ cháng
storyLang.english: The teaching pointer is long, and the pencil is short. The teaching pointer is longer than the pencil.

storyLang.pinyin: qiān bǐ cháng shuǐ cǎi bǐ duǎn qiān bǐ bǐ shuǐ cǎi bǐ cháng
storyLang.english: The pencil is long, and the colored marker is short. The pencil is longer than the colored marker.

storyLang.pinyin: shuǐ cǎi bǐ cháng bái bǎn bǐ duǎn shuǐ cǎi bǐ bǐ bái bǎn bǐ cháng
storyLang.english: The colored marker is long, and the whiteboard marker is short. The colored marker is longer than the whiteboard marker.

storyLang.pinyin: bái bǎn bǐ cháng là bǐ duǎn bái bǎn bǐ bǐ là bǐ cháng
storyLang.english: The whiteboard marker is long, and the crayon is short. The whiteboard marker is longer than the crayon.

storyLang.pinyin: là bǐ cháng xiàng pí duǎn là bǐ bǐ xiàng pí cháng
storyLang.english: The crayon is long, and the eraser is short. The crayon is longer than the eraser.
